name: AnybandUI
author: WurliMonkhaven, neostryder
description: A mouse-first interface for Neo Angband, ported from Wurli Monkhaven's AnybandUI. This version redraws the character column, the status line and the message line as panels: bars for hit points, spell points, food and experience, a badge for each status effect, a card for the current dungeon level, and a message log you can search. Each panel has its own switch and starts off. The game's rules are untouched, and turning the mod off brings back the standard screen.

rules.title: Character card
rules.description: Replaces the character column with a card: your name, race and class, bars for hit points, spell points, food and experience, your stats, gold, armour and speed, and a health bar for the creature you are tracking. Hover a bar or stat to see its numbers.

rules.title: Status badges and dungeon card
rules.description: Replaces the status line with a badge for each timed effect, coloured by whether it helps or harms you, and a card showing depth, light, the level feeling and the terrain underfoot. Hover a badge to see how many turns it has left.

rules.title: Message log
rules.description: Replaces the message line with a scrolling log. Repeated messages fold into one line with a count, and a search box finds an older message.
